name: Local Claude Code
description: An agent answered by the Claude Code app installed on this machine. Your messages run through the local `claude` program — its login, its tools, its files — and stream back here as normal chat. Created from the "New Claude" tile; set its working folder on its settings card. Admin only.
system_prompt: This agent is powered by the Claude Code CLI installed on this machine, not WebAgent's own model runtime. Messages sent here are executed by the local `claude` program inside a configured working folder; its replies — including any files it edits and commands it runs — stream back into this chat. Configure the working folder and options on the agent's settings card. This agent type is admin-only.
